description: This file defines a PHP class 'Basic' which extends the Controller class from the OpenCart system. It implements CAPTCHA functionality, including generating and validating CAPTCHA images, for the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Basic
classes.description: A controller class handling CAPTCHA image generation and validation for the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language, sets route data, generates a CAPTCHA token, and returns the CAPTCHA view.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates CAPTCHA input against stored session data and returns an error message or empty string.

methods.name: captcha
methods.description: Generates a CAPTCHA image with random shapes and the CAPTCHA text, then outputs it as JPEG.
